items.text: The game is fun, it'll take a min to learn, and the biggest problem I have is you are almost required to break the laws for example get to a locker behind a locked door for a job that pays 1k-2k but then youi get nabbed for braking the law and you pay 15k, but the frusterating thing is did you get nabbed for hacking open the door that no on saw you open, or was it something you you did 27 saves ago, who knows the game, best I can tell doesn't tell you what crime you did or why your wanted dead or alive. I played game were I brake ever law I can and go a long time with out the cops looking for me and then I've play the good guy and try to do everything legit and with little or no warning am wanted dead or alive; so I dont know if it's a bug, but in either case (this is for you devs) can you have the cop and or the judge tell me what, when, I broke the and 15k for every law broken seem dull.
items.text_zh: 这个游戏很有趣，学起来需要一点时间，而我最大的问题是，你几乎必须违法，比如为了一个报酬1千到2千的工作，去打开一扇锁着的门后面的储物柜，但然后你会因为违法而被抓，然后你付1万5，但令人沮丧的是，你是因为黑开那扇没人看见你打开的门而被抓，还是因为你在27次存档之前做的某件事，谁知道呢，这游戏，据我所知，不会告诉你你犯了什么罪，或者为什么你被悬赏死活不论。我玩过那种我违反我能违反的每一条法律，然后很长时间都没有警察找我，然后我也玩过当好人，试图做一切合法的事，然后几乎没有任何警告就被悬赏死活不论；所以我不知道这是不是个bug，但无论哪种情况（这是给你们的，开发者们），你们能不能让警察和/或法官告诉我，我什么时候，犯了什么法，而且每违反一条法律就罚1万5，这看起来很无聊。

observations.description: 玩家守法时突然被通缉，违法时却长时间不被追捕，通缉机制不一致。
observations.evidence: I played game were I brake ever law I can and go a long time with out the cops looking for me and then I've play the good guy and try to do everything legit and with little or no warning am wanted dead or alive
observations.evidence_zh: 我玩的时候能犯的法全犯了个遍，很长时间都没有警察来找我，然后我又扮演好人，尽量一切都合法地做，结果几乎毫无预警地就被悬赏死活不论了
